name: Halikar Wraith
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack relics, sell Prime parts at a Relay Ducat Kiosk

alt.text: or 90 Aya at Varzia, 5 Ducats each

conditions: Ducats are untradeable; only the Prime parts that sell for them trade.
bonuses: Meso D8 has a 45-Ducat part in the common slot, so it pays well even intact.

groups.activity: buy it on a visit that stocks it
groups.meta: every two weeks for 48 hours; stock rotates

rows.label: Halikar Wraith
rows.note: arrives built, no blueprint or foundry step

conditions: Baro only stocks it on some visits, historically two to four times a year; missing the 48-hour window can mean months.
MR 13 to equip, so it gives no Mastery until then.

disclosures.title: other routes
disclosures.body: Baro's week-long TennoCon Relay, normally in July, carries his full catalogue, but entry needs Baro's Relay Ticket from the paid TennoCon digital pack. It is tradeable, so buying one from another player (recipient MR 13) also works.
